title: Scenario share link payload (#rzs=)
description: Decoded payload of a calculator share link: base64url(UTF-8 JSON) after '#rzs='. Readers: js/rz-scenario.js readLink(). A new field means a version bump plus a reader update in the same release (ARCHITECTURE-P C4); tools/test-scenario-share-links.mjs checks the reader's limits equal the ones here.

origin.description: Optional. Where the link was made (e.g. an incident dossier). Never navigated to, never inserted as HTML.
